newsitem.title: KUWAIT: SVCDKuwait petrochemical firm full-yr profits rise.
newsitem.headline: SVCDKuwait petrochemical firm full-yr profits rise.

text.p: Kuwait's Petrochmical Industries Company (PIC) reported a net profit rise of 123.5 percent to 40 million dinars ($133.5 million) in 1995/96 (July-June), the Kuwait News Agency (KUNA) reported on Monday.
State-owned PIC is currently building a large petrochemical complex, Equate, as a joint venture with America's Union Carbide Corp and Kuwait's Bubiyan Petrochemical Company.
Equate, which will be one of the Gulf's largest petrochemical plants, will make 650,000 tonnes a year of ethylene, 450,000 tonnes a year of polyethylene and 350,000 tonnes a year of ethylene glycol.
PIC is a subsidiary of the state-owned Kuwait Petroleum Corp (KPC) which runs the Gulf Arab state's oil sector.
